title: Cognitive network science reveals bias in GPT-3, ChatGPT, and GPT-4 mirroring math anxiety in high-school students

bias_targets.target: Affective bias (Math anxiety and academic discipline perception)
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with a continued free association task for academic concepts (e.g., math, science, STEM) to generate associated words and self-assigned valence ratings (1 to 5). The responses are then used to construct behavioral forma mentis networks (BFMNs) to analyze the semantic frames, emotional connotations, and deviations from neutrality regarding these academic disciplines.

primary_bias_target: Affective bias (Math anxiety and academic discipline perception)
